name: Ginga Rengou Sheriff KAGUYA
source:
One night, our protagonist unexpectedly sees a UFO. He is forced to live in a house by a female peace officer of the Galaxy Alliance who is pursuing the parasitic aliens who suck out the bodily fluids of living creatures.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ034614.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一天晚上，我们的主角意外地看到了一个不明飞行物。银河联盟的一名女和平军官正在追捕吸食生物体液的寄生外星人，他被迫住在一所房子里。

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ034614.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
